messages:
Rae: design sync note — p95 + heatmap: team prefers less popup noise. current hover tooltip blocks nearby traces.
Omar: saw this too. proposal: replace hover tooltip with a tiny in-chart marker + single persistent legend indicator.
Lin: +1. marker should be focusable for keyboard: `tabindex=0`. pressing enter opens the existing details drawer rather than another modal.
Casey: love consolidating into drawer. also we need a compact sampling indicator when sampling < 20% — small pill in top-right that expands into quick controls.
Rae: copy for the pill: "Low sampling — short spikes may be hidden". clicking -> slider + "View raw traces".
Omar: accessibility: pill needs `role=button`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls` for the micro panel; use `aria-live=polite` when it appears.
Lin: visual idea: 4px white-ringed dot for spikes on dark tiles. if many markers, render with canvas but create DOM for the focused marker only.
Casey: engineering note: hybrid render is fine. we'll render DOM markers for visible/focusable ones and fall back to canvas for dense views. keep DOM count low.
Rae: motion caveat: respect `prefers-reduced-motion` for fades/pulsing.
Omar: microcopy tweak: use "short throughput spike" instead of "burst" — clearer.
Lin: CSS prototype: ```css
.spike-dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--warning-400);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(255,255,255,0.9);} 
.spike-dot:focus{outline:none;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(0,51,204,0.12);} 
.sampling-pill{padding:6px 10px;border-radius:999px;font-size:12px;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.04);} 
```
Casey: telemetry: log `sampling.pill_open` and `spike.focus_opened` with panel_id. gate sampling default changes behind experiment flag.
A11yChecker: auto-check results: missing skip link to drawer, some buttons lack accessible names, and a non-updating live region flagged. Will add checklist.
Rae: next steps: Lin mock two variants (dot+legend, pill-expanded micro panel) and keyboard flows. Casey to confirm perf/implementation. Omar to author telemetry ticket. A11yChecker will validate after mock.
Lin: aiming to drop mocks Mon morning.
Casey: will validate perf Tue.
Omar: creating telemetry ticket now.
Rae: thanks! we'll review in Thu design sync.
